title: Boba · Social intelligence for your goals and your people
excerpt: Text Boba, add it to your group chat, or message it online at boba.app. It remembers what matters and knows when to speak up. Free.

Free · No app · No sign-up

The AI that gets

Text it or use it on the web, one-on-one or in your group chats.

One-on-one

Boba

7:30 is open. Booked ✅ The confirmation is in your email.

Reads the room

At home in group chats

Boba stays quiet during normal chatter and speaks up when it can actually help: pricing out the trip, finding the restaurant, keeping the grocery list, reminding everyone about game night. It picks up on your group's style as it goes, and you can remove it any time.

Text Boba once, then add it to any group chat right from your Messages app, just like adding a friend.

Why it's different

Built to follow through

Most AI answers one request at a time. Boba works toward the goals you share with it, and it understands the people involved.

It speaks up first

Boba keeps track of what's coming. Got a trip? It checks the weather and your flights ahead of time and flags problems before you ask.

heads up: storms in Denver Saturday ⛈️ your 2:10 connection could slip. want a backup route?

yes please

It gets the people involved

Boba picks up on social cues. When a group can't agree, it figures out what each person needs and finds the plan that works.

Jon

saturday is bad for me 😕

Boba

Sunday works for all 5 of you, and the place is open till 3. move it?

It sticks with you

People work on goals with Boba for weeks or months. It remembers the plan and breaks it down day by day.

week 6 of marathon training 🏃 easy 5 miles today. how's the knee?

better! did 6

Real story

The free trial that wasn't

One user had Boba read the fine print on a supplement trial. It would have rolled into a paid subscription, so Boba helped cancel it in time.

Real story

The airline pulled out

An airline stopped flying to one user's city. Boba dug up alternate routes so the trip could still happen.

Real story

The job hunt

Several users worked with Boba to polish their resumes, search job boards, and apply for jobs.

What it can do

All from the chat

Reminders & invites

Ask once by text. Boba sends the nudge, or the calendar invite to everyone.

Web research

Prices, hours, routes, reviews. Boba looks it up and gives you the short version.

Email

Connect Gmail or Outlook. Boba flags what matters and drafts replies for you to send.

Gets things done onlinealpha

Boba can work through real websites for you, from forms to bookings, and asks before anything big.

Memory

It remembers your plans, preferences and people, so you never start from scratch.

Group chats

Add Boba to any group. It stays quiet until it can actually help.

Images & songs

Make or edit pictures and write songs with friends, right in the thread.

Phone or web

Text it on iPhone or Android, or use it in your browser at web.boba.app.

Good questions

Before you say hi

Is Boba really free?

Yes. No subscription, no ads. Free to use.

Does it work on Android?

Yes. Boba works over RCS and plain SMS, so any Android phone can text it. Tap Open Messages here or text the number shown, and you're in. Boba also works in group chats that mix iPhone and Android. Turning on chat features (RCS) in Google Messages gets you the richer experience, with typing indicators and full-size photos.

How do I add Boba to a group chat?

Text Boba 1:1 first. Then add the Boba number to any group from your Messages app, same as adding any other contact.

Do I need to download an app?

No. Text Boba from the Messages app you already have (iMessage on iPhone, Google Messages on Android), or use it in your browser at web.boba.app. There's nothing to install.

How do I start?

Tap Open Messages and send the pre-written message. Your invite code travels with it automatically, and that first text is your sign-up.

What can I actually ask it?

The things early users lean on most: reminders and calendar invites, a morning brief, check-ins on goals and habits, handling email, booking a table or a flight once you say yes, reading the fine print, and researching and pricing out a trip. In a group chat it plans with everyone, keeps shared lists, and knows when to stay quiet.

How does Boba safeguard my data?

Messages are stored so the conversation has memory. We may use them to improve our AI and future products, but we never sell them to advertisers or use them to train third-party models. Your phone number is only used to deliver the service. Full details in Privacy Notice.

What people actually use it for

Real life, handled by text.

Boba plans, books, reminds and keeps track, one-on-one and in group chats. Connect your email and calendar and it handles those too, and it books things once you say yes.

Group chat

Prices out the trip

Drop Boba in the trip chat. It researches cabins, flights and trains, splits the cost, and lays out options everyone can weigh in on.

TCTahoe trip 🏔️

Theo

cabin for 6, last weekend of june?

Boba

3 good ones under $1,800. Pinecrest works out to $290 each, hot tub included 👀

pinecrest!! send the link

One-on-one

Nags you just enough

Meeting reminders, check-ins on your meds or the appointment you keep pushing. Boba follows up so you don't have to.

Boba

remind me to take my meds at 9 every night

set 💊 9pm daily. I'll check in if you go quiet on me

Group chat

The family's shared memory

Grocery lists, school pickups, appointments. Add Boba to the family chat and it keeps track of who's doing what.

One-on-one

Your inbox, handled

Connect Gmail or Outlook. Boba flags what matters, drafts replies and puts plans on your calendar.

anything in my email i need to deal with?

Just one: your landlord needs the renewal signed by Friday. Want me to draft a reply?

Drafted ✅ Want me to send it?

Group chat

Keeps the standing plans going

Weekly pickleball, board game night, the Sunday walk. Boba checks who's in, finds a time and a place, and reminds everyone the day before.

One-on-one

Get the table, not just the idea

Name the place and the time, and Boba books it once you say yes.

Boba

can you get us a table for 2 at Rina's tonight, 7:30?

7:30 is open. Booked ✅ The confirmation is in your email.

读房间

At home in group chats

Boba stays quiet during normal chatter and speaks up when it can actually help: pricing out the trip, finding the restaurant, keeping the grocery list, reminding everyone about game night. It picks up on your group's style as it goes, and you can remove it any time.

Text Boba once, then add it to any group chat right from your Messages app, just like adding a friend.

为什么不一样

Built to follow through

Most AI answers one request at a time. Boba works toward the goals you share with it, and it understands the people involved.

It speaks up first

Boba keeps track of what's coming. Got a trip? It checks the weather and your flights ahead of time and flags problems before you ask.

heads up: storms in Denver Saturday ⛈️ your 2:10 connection could slip. want a backup route?

yes please

It gets the people involved

Boba picks up on social cues. When a group can't agree, it figures out what each person needs and finds the plan that works.

Jon

saturday is bad for me 😕

Boba

Sunday works for all 5 of you, and the place is open till 3. move it?

It sticks with you

People work on goals with Boba for weeks or months. It remembers the plan and breaks it down day by day.

week 6 of marathon training 🏃 easy 5 miles today. how's the knee?

better! did 6

Phone or web

Good questions

Before you say hi

Is Boba really free?

是的。 No subscription, no ads. 免费使用。

Does it work on Android?

是的。 Boba works over RCS and plain SMS, so any Android phone can text it. Tap Open Messages here or text the number shown, and you're in. Boba also works in group chats that mix iPhone and Android. Turning on chat features (RCS) in Google Messages gets you the richer experience, with typing indicators and full-size photos.

How do I add Boba to a group chat?

Text Boba 1:1 first. Then add the Boba number to any group from your Messages app, same as adding any other contact.

Do I need to download an app?

No. Text Boba from the Messages app you already have (iMessage on iPhone, Google Messages on Android), or use it in your browser at web.boba.app. There's nothing to install.

How do I start?

Tap Open Messages and send the pre-written message. Your invite code travels with it automatically, and that first text is your sign-up.

What can I actually ask it?

The things early users lean on most: reminders and calendar invites, a morning brief, check-ins on goals and habits, handling email, booking a table or a flight once you say yes, reading the fine print, and researching and pricing out a trip. In a group chat it plans with everyone, keeps shared lists, and knows when to stay quiet.

How does Boba safeguard my data?

Messages are stored so the conversation has memory. We may use them to improve our AI and future products, but we never sell them to advertisers or use them to train third-party models. Your phone number is only used to deliver the service. Full details in Privacy Notice.
